infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Geocatch uses the camera so you can photograph the spot you’re logging in the field.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Geocatch imports photos from your library so existing field shots can become observations.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Geocatch uses location only when a photo has no GPS, and to center map pins. Free-plan data stays on your device.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Geocatch to import field photos into your journal.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Geocatch to photograph the spot you’re logging.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Geocatch to place observations when a photo has no GPS, and to center map pins. Free-plan data stays on device.
